text:
maria: seeing ~30% pod-to-pod packet loss in us-west gpu pool, started ~09:10. KV-sync errors and RDMA handshakes failing on several slices. anyone else?
aj: seeing the same, alerts for rpc_retries and grpc timeouts spiking. dashboards: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/GPUPool
tim: any recent netpol or chart changes in gpu-slices namespace?
sre-bot: deploy-bot: networkpolicy/networkpolicy-gpu-slice-egress was applied to namespace 'gpu-slices' by aj at 2024-11-28T09:05:12Z
aj: I rolled out a tighten-up policy yesterday to isolate slices — restrict egress to cluster-internal on port 50051 only. thought it was safe.
maria: weird that only some pods are impacted, others in same ns are fine. suggests selector mismatch?
tim: try `kubectl get pods --show-labels -n gpu-slices | grep slice` — maybe labels drifted during a chart deploy or autoscaler changed templates.
aj: running checks now... yep: older pods have label `slice=1` while new replica sets set `slice-id=1`. the networkpolicy was written as `podSelector.matchLabels: {"slice-id":"1"}` so pods with `slice` were allowed earlier, new pods are excluded.
maria: calicoctl logs show tcp: denied due to selector mismatch for dest pod, conntrack entries show SYNs but reply dropped. tcpdump on node confirms SYNs to 10.240.x.x with no SYN-ACK.
aj: patching policy to include both selectors as emergency fix. applying: ```
kubectl patch networkpolicy networkpolicy-gpu-slice-egress -n gpu-slices --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/podSelector/matchExpressions","value":[{"key":"slice","operator":"In","values":["1"]}]}]'
```
maria: applied, re-evaluating traffic...
sre-bot: networkpolicy/networkpolicy-gpu-slice-egress patched by aj at 2024-11-28T09:24:03Z
aj: traffic restored for affected pods, KV-sync errors dropped to baseline (~1/min). RDMA handshake failures cleared. :thumbsup:
tim: long term: we need chart migration to a single canonical label, plus an admission webhook to reject incompatible label changes. also add a CI netpol lint and an alert for denied-packet-rate > 50/min for gpu-slices.
maria: filing a short incident postmortem and follow-ups: 1) update all slice charts to use `slice-id` (or standardize on `slice`) 2) add admission webhook 3) CI linter + gating for netpol changes 4) backfill metrics to detect selector mismatches. assigning owners and due dates.
aj: opening PRs for the chart fix and the emergency patch rollback (we'll keep multi-selector for 24h then revert once labels reconciled).
tim: let's schedule a canary in staging to test netpol changes before prod.
maria: thanks all, marking incident resolved for now, will post PM after owners sign off.
